Warning everyone please read this review carefully before visiting this service centre. If you are visually challenged so I can recommend don't visit at all.My experience at the iQOO/Vivo Service Center (Infiniti Mall, Malad West) was highly disappointing and technically incompetent.
​1. Technical Negligence & Poor Re-assembly:
I visited for a loudspeaker issue on my iQOO Neo 10. They opened the phone, but the re-assembly was faulty. It created a NEW hardware problem—the back panel started making loud creaking and clicking sounds. Warning: They provided NO job sheet at the counter during the first visit, leaving me with no proof of their initial mistake.
​2. Shifting Defects (Job ID: MWINMH01020260220000001):
On my follow-up, they tried to fix the back panel, but the clicking noise simply shifted to the side. This shows they are unable to properly seal a high-end device.
​3. Inaccurate & Offensive Remarks:
Engineer Deepika recorded in the official report that because I am "Blind," I only "feel" a crack sound while using TalkBack. This is a deceptive attempt to dismiss a hardware defect. I can clearly HEAR the hardware clicking; it has nothing to do with TalkBack. Using a customer's disability as a "cover" for a technical failure is unacceptable and discriminatory.
​4. Lack of Transparency (Staff: Sangeeta Dwivedi):
The staff withheld the job sheet at the counter and only sent a PDF via WhatsApp over an hour after I left. This is a tactic to prevent you from challenging incorrect remarks or poor service while you are still at the center.
​5. Structural Integrity & Water Damage Risk:
The report admits a "small gap" in the sealing. For any user, especially those of us who rely on our devices for accessibility, a compromised seal is a major risk for water damage. I have put it on record: if this gap leads to failure, they are fully responsible for a replacement.
​Final Advice: If you are visually challenged, be extremely careful here. Insist on a physical job sheet before leaving and have someone double-check the "Remarks" section to ensure they aren't using your condition to hide their technical failure.
